about: The values of the public site that only its owner knows. Edit them here and run
npm run site:build: scripts/build-site.mjs stamps them into every page.
contactEmail, appStoreUrl and googlePlayUrl start empty. While one is empty the pages say so in
plain words ("Coming soon to the App Store", no dead link) and the build lists it as still to set.
The store addresses are the app's own pages: https://apps.apple.com/app/id... and
siteUrl is where the site is served. Links between the pages are relative and do not use it;
only the canonical, hreflang and share-image addresses in each page's head do.
developer is the name the privacy policy and the footer give for who makes the app.
